MEET TRACEY

At the heart of my work is a simple belief: high performance begins with inner clarity.

The way we think, the stories we tell ourselves, the beliefs we hold, and the language we use shape every decision we make, every relationship we build, and every outcome we create.

Tracey is a highly respected mind management coach and trusted confidante at some of the highest levels of media, politics, sports, business and government.

ABOUT TRACEY  ›
Because when you change your language, you change your thinking. When you change your thinking, you change your leadership. And when you learn to lead yourself first, everything changes.

A TRUSTED SPACE FOR GROWTH, REFLECTION AND TRANSFORMATION

Whether you are navigating a significant life transition, leading under pressure, supporting others, or striving to reach your next level personally or professionally, my work is designed to help you think more clearly, understand yourself more deeply, and move forward with confidence.

LANGUAGE ALCHEMY™ COACHING

Language is more than communication.It is the gateway to the mind.

The words we choose reveal our beliefs, shape our emotional patterns and influence every decision we make. When people learn to hear their own language differently, they begin to understand themselves differently.

From that place, everything changes.

SPECIALIST SUPPORT  ·  WHO I WORK WITH

BEYOND ONE-TO-ONE

Support that reaches every part of a client’s world.

A wraparound service

For her private clients, Tracey has created a wraparound service that extends to the people around them, including household staff, yacht crew and those working in the political space, so the support is consistent across every part of their world.

Teams that hold steady

Tracey places equal emphasis on the dynamics within teams. By helping people recognise their pressure points and triggers, she equips them to coach themselves, coach others and stay steady through challenge, creating teams that are high-performing, grounded, connected and psychologically safe.

On the world stage

A sought-after international keynote speaker, Tracey brings more than expertise to the stage. She shares her own journey of change, the challenges that tested her and the lessons that shaped her practice, showing audiences around the world how the power of the mind transforms personal and professional success. Through Chrysalis Mindset she continues to support educators and school leaders to thrive, the work where her own journey began.
